notes:
- **Auto-Update Reliability & Health Diagnostics**: Moved staged update APKs out of volatile cache storage into persistent app files, kept verified APKs across user cancels, added ETag/no-cache manifest revalidation, throttled the install-permission reminder to 24h, and added an Auto-Update Health card in Settings with a one-tap battery optimization shortcut.
- **Polished Update UX**: Rendered Markdown bold/bullets in release notes, surfaced live download speed & ETA across Settings, Home, and Update screens, auto-started mobile downloads when toggling the setting on, and added a dismissible in-app What's New card after silent background updates.
